channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: WATCH: Why students are silenced — and how to fight back
item.description: The College Fix's Hannah Brady sits down with the Alliance Defending Freedom's Senior Counsel Travis Barham, who runs his group's Center for Academic Freedom.

item.title: Heavy social media use linked with loneliness in college students, new research finds
item.description: Excessive social media use among college students is strongly associated with self‑reported feelings of loneliness and isolation, a University of Cincinnati study has found.

item.title: UTenn removes Native American ‘knowledge that we weren’t supposed to be sharing’
item.description: The infiltration of Marxism into archaeology threatens the pursuit of knowledge, as evidenced by the University of Tennessee's removal of displays about Native American cultures.

item.title: Utah college religious exemptions bill prompts academic freedom concerns
item.description: A Utah bill allowing religious exemptions for college assignments has raised concerns among some academics about its impact on academic freedom and critical thinking.

item.title: U. Maryland drops most charges against student journalists detained during pro-Israel event
item.description: Free speech group, pro-Israel activists dispute whether journalists wrongly detained The University of Maryland recently dropped three of four charges against two journalists from the Muslim student newspaper Al-Hikmah who were detained by campus police while covering a pro-Israel event. The dropped charges include disrupting others’ lawful freedom of expression, engaging in disorderly conduct that […]

item.title: Scholar calls for ‘jihad,’ praises murder of ‘Zionists’ at Union seminary students’ event
item.description: At an online event, scholar Muhammad Abdou urged students to 'be a threat' and praised the assassination of two 'Zionists.'

item.title: Columbia student worker union authorizes strike, seeks protections for non-citizens
item.description: Union seeks amnesty for disciplined protesters A labor union representing over 3,000 student workers at Columbia University voted Tuesday to approve a potential strike after months of negotiating with the school for higher wages and protections for non-citizens. item.title: Education Department sits on nearly 400 college discrimination complaints from one activist
item.description: Civil rights activist Mark Perry said the Department of Education refuses to provide updates on hundreds of discrimination complaints.

item.title: U. Mary Washington College GOP faces doxing threats ahead of Nick Freitas talk
item.description: The University of Mary Washington's College Republicans hosted Nick Freitas despite doxing threats, showing their courage and commitment free speech.

item.title: Stefanik bill would reform Truman scholars program after years of bias against conservatives
item.description: Each year, the Harry S. Truman Scholarship Foundation provides $30,000 to about 50 students for graduate school in exchange for pledging three years of work in public service.
